findings.claim: The config topic sends the reader to `/aid-help init` for "the full list of what a fresh init produces", but the init topic's `Creates:` line omits `config/permissions.yaml` (and the `.aid-o/.gitignore` + `work/` files), so the promised full list is incomplete — and it omits exactly the file the config topic itself highlights two lines earlier.
findings.fix: Either add `config/permissions.yaml` (and note the workspace files) to the init topic's `Creates:` list so it matches `commands/aid-init.md` "Files Created (11 total)", or drop the words "full list" in the config topic and say it names the config files only.
